_about: 1,3-Propanediol (1) + 1-Hexanol (2): isobaric bubble temperatures at 101.3 kPa (no vapour compositions are fitted). Rows: liquid mole fraction of 1,3-propanediol, boiling temperature in K, as stored in the ThermoML Archive record (mole fractions of the other component converted with x_1 = 1 - x_2).

source.citation: M. A. Khoshooei, D. Sharp, A. Afacan, G. P. Dechaine, Vapor-liquid equilibrium data of binary mixtures of 1-hexanol, 1-heptanol, 1-nonanol and 1,3-propanediol at P = 101.3 kPa using differential scanning calorimetry (DSC), J. Chem. Thermodyn. 132 (2019) 105-112
source.access: The journal article may be subscription-only; the same data is public in the NIST TRC ThermoML Archive (NIST open license).
source.tables: ThermoML record, PureOrMixtureData 7. The table number in the article was not checked.

notes: Read with validation/python/vle_batch.py. Fitted to the bubble temperatures alone (Barker's method): no set of this pair with vapour compositions passes the consistency point test, or none was measured. Pure-component boiling points of the set within 0.97 K of the vapour-pressure records. To be checked by a person against the record (AGENTS.md rule 4).
